blocks.text: The Korea Agro-Fisheries & Food Trade Corporation (aT) ASEAN Regional Headquarters successfully staged “Taste of Wonder, K-Food Manila 2026” on November 16 and 17 at the Glorietta Palm Drive Activity Center in Makati City, drawing crowds of Filipino food enthusiasts, families, and K-culture fans. The activity center was packed with visitors eager to explore Korean food, fresh produce, cooking experiences, and entertainment. During the opening ceremony, Kyoung-cheol Kim, Director of the aT ASEAN Regional Headquarters, welcomed guests and highlighted the growing interest in Korean food in the Philippines, driven in part by the popularity of K-pop and Korean dramas. “In recent […]...
